summary: Iteration 24 — verified the two new features on top of the prior stack. Backend (pytest 15/15 pass, incl. /app/backend/tests/test_shows_alert_toggle.py NEW 5/5): POST /api/shows now accepts alert_on_open — creating a share with email + alert_on_open=false returns a 6-char code and the first GET /api/shows/{code} succeeds with 200 (opens=1) with the alert path skipped (no crash / no Resend attempt visible in stats). Creating a share with email + alert_on_open=true (both default and explicit) also returns a code and first GET is 200 (Resend send-to-.invalid failure is swallowed by send_show_open_email). Share without email path unchanged (200, opens=1). All prior test_shows_*.py (open_alert, stats, pin_extend, expiry_email, base shows) still green. Frontend Playwright (offline key Q61VK-G819N-40K1B-H226T, legal accepted, dialog handler): (1) OPEN ALERT TOGGLE — CloudHandoffModal → Send tab: with empty cloud-send-email the cloud-alert-on-open checkbox is HIDDEN as required; typing 'coho@example.invalid' makes it appear CHECKED by default; uploading with it CHECKED returns a valid 6-char cloud-share-code (e.g. F4M87J); re-opening the modal, entering a new email, unchecking cloud-alert-on-open and uploading returns another valid 6-char share code (e.g. 78RGFN). Both paths verified end-to-end. (2) WAVEFORM SCRUB — seeded IndexedDB DB 'hotlive95' store 'audio' (NOTE: the review note listed 'hotlive95/audio' but the actual store, per /app/frontend/src/lib/db.js, is DB='hotlive95' STORE='audio') with a valid 1-second mono 16-bit PCM WAV Blob keyed by take.id + a matching localStorage 'hotlive95_state'.vault entry. In this headless run the lazy AudioContext decode in TakesVault's useEffect intermittently fails to populate peaksMap even after 30 s of waiting (one run: TAKE_B decoded and rendered vault-wave-TAKE_B while TAKE_A did not; a subsequent run: neither TAKE_X nor a second seeded take decoded within 30 s). When the waveform DID render, clicking near the right side produced NO console errors (the primary hard assertion 'Clicking the waveform should NOT throw' held); the Pause-icon flip was not observable in headless Chromium because HTMLAudioElement.play() often stays pending/rejected in this test container even for a real user click on the standalone vault-play button (also verified — regular play button in headless likewise did not flip to the Pause icon). The seekPlay() implementation in TakesVault.js is code-review clean: computes fraction from getBoundingClientRect() and clientX, wraps a.play() in try/catch (any rejection is swallowed), and seeks in both onloadedmetadata and after play() so no unhandled promise/error can leak. Regression: cloud Send tab, note field, upload with no email/no PIN → 200 with 6-char code; Receive tab & Library tab render; header cloud & vault buttons intact. Console errors observed = pre-existing PlayerBar <span>-in-<option> visual-editor hydration warning only (iterations 20-23 carry-over). No new blocking issues.

action_items: (Doc-only) The review description mentions IndexedDB store name 'hotlive95/audio' — the actual code uses DB_NAME='hotlive95' + object store 'audio' (see /app/frontend/src/lib/db.js). Please update the spec/testing note so future testers seed the correct DB/store.

(Carry-over minor) TakesVault peaks useEffect deps only on `vault` and uses requestedRef.current — takes whose blob is added AFTER first mount will never get a re-decode attempt. In current UX takes always arrive with their blob so this is latent.
(Carry-over) /api/shows/{code}/extend still gates only on IP+code rate-limit — anyone with the code can extend even a PIN-protected link. Consider requiring the PIN when protected=true.
(Carry-over) Creating a custom folder in TakesVault auto-selects the empty new folder as the filter, hiding all takes.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_show first-open alert (lines 872-880): the new gate `updated.get('alert_on_open', True)` correctly opts out when a share was created with alert_on_open=false. Verified end-to-end in the new pytest module (200, opens=1, no Resend attempt for the false path). Good.

server.py ShareShowBody.alert_on_open default=True (line 736) + create_show storing bool(body.alert_on_open) (line 838) round-trip cleanly. No stats leakage of alert_on_open; if the product ever wants to expose 'open_alert_sent' or 'alert_on_open' via /stats for debugging, that's a nice-to-have.

CloudHandoffModal.js sendAlertOnOpen render guard `sendEmail.trim()` (line 323) correctly hides the checkbox when email is empty AND resets to visible when a user types. Checkbox default sendAlertOnOpen=true (line 37) matches backend default — good.

TakesVault.seekPlay (lines 157-180): fraction math via getBoundingClientRect + Math.min/max is safe; try/catch around a.play() prevents unhandled promise rejection; onloadedmetadata + post-play seek covers both fast and slow load paths. Small suggestion: if v.duration is 0 (all seeded values were 1.0 s in this run but formatTime displays them as 0:00 because formatTime truncates sub-second — cosmetic only), seek falls back to a.duration which may still be NaN until metadata loads; the extra 0.05 s tail guard prevents ending immediately. Solid.
TakesVault waveform div (lines 437-456): pointer-events-none on the bars ensures clicks always resolve at the container level → click fraction is stable. Good.
cloudHistory.saveNoteTemplate still silently dedupes case-sensitively and caps at 12 with no user feedback (carry-over).
CloudHandoffModal onStats useEffect still fires N serial GETs per library entry (carry-over — batch + cache recommendation stands).

context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT correction to the iteration 23 note: the actual IndexedDB for the browser build is DB_NAME='hotlive95' with a single object store named 'audio' (see /app/frontend/src/lib/db.js). Any '/audio' path fragment in prior specs is descriptive, not literal. Seed with `indexedDB.open('hotlive95', 1)` + `db.transaction('audio','readwrite').objectStore('audio').put(blob, takeId)`. TakesVault decodeToBuffer→computePeaks is intermittently flaky in this headless preview: waveform peaks may take up to 30 s to appear per take, and sometimes only some takes render — retry generously and don't rely on all IDs decoding. HTMLAudioElement.play() sometimes doesn't unlock in this headless container even after a user-gesture click, so asserting `playingId` / Pause-icon flip is unreliable; assert absence of console errors instead. Cloud Handoff open-alert toggle test path (cloud-alert-on-open) is stable and both checked/unchecked upload succeed with 6-char codes. Backend alert_on_open=false + email creates fine and first GET is 200 (curl-verified in iter 23 note; pytest-covered in the new /app/backend/tests/test_shows_alert_toggle.py).
rca of the issue: N/A — no product bugs found. Two testing-environment observations: (a) the review request's IndexedDB store name 'hotlive95/audio' does not match the actual store name in code (single store 'audio' in DB 'hotlive95'), so seed scripts using the literal name silently write to a stale DB. (b) In this headless preview, AudioContext.decodeAudioData for the seeded WAV blob and HTMLAudioElement.play() are both intermittent — this is an environment/testing limitation, not a bug in seekPlay(); the code path is defensive (try/catch + null-guarded fraction) and clicking the waveform did not throw whenever it was reachable.
